title: Momekano ya mposa ya mai
intro: Lisanga moko, oyo ezalaki na mposa makasi ya bokambi mpo na kobatela likambo na bango, esɛngaki ete bápona mokonzi moko likoló na bango. Ntango eyanolamaki na bosenga na bango, moto oyo aponami akutanaki na ntembe, mpamba te moto yango azalaki na ezalela ya mokili oyo bakanisaki te. Yambo ya bokutani ya nsuka, mokambi oyo ya sika akomeka disipilini mpenza ya basoda na komekama ya pete, kasi ya mozindo, ya bopekisami.
clues: Naponamaki lokola mokonzi sima ya bato na ngai kosenga mokambi moko abunda na nzela ya Allah.
Bato mingi na ngai moko batyaki ntembe na ebandeli mpo na koponama na ngai, kolobeláká ete nazalaki na bozwi te mpe nazalaki na molɔngɔ ya bato ya lokumu.
Naponamaki mpo ete Allah apesaki ngai boyebi mingi mpe molai ya nzoto ya nguya.
Elembo ya polele ya boponi na ngai ya bonzambe ezalaki bozongi ya Sanduku ya Boyokani, ememamaki na baanzelu, oyo ememaki kimia na mitema ya bandimi.
Ntango nazalaki kotambola elongo na basoda na ngai, nayebisaki ete tokomekama na ebale moko.
Natindaki mampinga na ngai ete moto nyonso oyo akomɛla mingi na ebale azalaki na kompanyi na ngai te, nzokande baoyo bazwaki kaka skɔpi moko na lobɔkɔ na bango bakotikala.

options: Kotonga epekiseli mpo na kobundisa Goge mpe Magoge
Kokutana na géant moko na etumba moko

Kokabola Mbu Motane mpo na kokima mokonzi moko ya bokonzi
Kosala dynastie oyo ewumeli na kombo na ngai
Kotonga Kaaba ya bule na Makkah
Kosekwa na lola kozanga kokufa

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
